protocol.task_units: BBH 27 subtasks plus GSM8K as one task
protocol.episode_unit: question IDs; same generation seed support/query; three seeds are repeated measurements
protocol.seen_mode: same task first half history, remaining pool split support/query
protocol.unseen_mode: entire target task excluded from base history
protocol.full_feedback: all 20 existing aggregate scores for support question at that generation seed
protocol.restricted_feedback: only default combination score; unknown actions remain unobserved
protocol.random_control: shuffle observed support rewards within action, support IDs fixed

support_feasibility.note: validation BBH subtasks have 3-4 questions; k=4 is infeasible for BBH and k4 rows are GSM8K only

scientific_decision.reason: Only one development validation permission/method/k combination has a positive episode-cluster interval; full-information evidence is not positive, restricted signal needs an independent fresh confirmation and BBH k4 is infeasible on validation.

interpretation_boundary: Validation200 is development diagnostics. A positive interval here does not establish independent task adaptation or justify meta-learning. Train episodes are not independent new tasks; three generation seeds are repeated measurements.
paired_ci_definition: Descriptive episode-cluster bootstrap: each support episode is one cluster after averaging its three same-seed repeated rows; tasks are equally weighted. Not a question-level independent CI.
